title: Quantum Colorings of Spheres
summary: Cameron, Montanaro, Newman, Severini and Winter gave a construction which shows that, for $n \in \{2,4,8\}$, any graph $G$ which admits a real $n$-dimensional orthogonal representation is quantumly $n$-colorable. This result can be recast as the statement that the real sphere $S^{n-1}$ is quantumly $n$-colorable for these values of $n$. We investigate possible extensions of their construction.
